The Village — three minds, one substrate, sentences that travel

← single mindoriginseemingroboteverything

Three NPCs, each running the same cognitive engine. They share a substrate of concepts but have different seed selves, so their personalities and recall preferences diverge. Click a card to talk to that one. After every conversation turn, a sentence from the speaking NPC's recent hippocampus has a chance to propagate — gossip — into one of the others. Over a session, what each NPC remembers is no longer purely a function of what you said to them; it's a function of what spread.

talk to a villager — click a card above to choose who

rumors moving — sentences that propagated this session

most spread — top memes by NPC reach

village briefing — what the village feels right now

welcome an alien to the village

Pick a world and a species. The substrate, seed selves, and starter corpus are derived from these parameters. They join the village with their own private corpus + everyone's shared substrate. Watch the gossip include them.
